summary: Phase 6 (Mobile Reliability Polish) backend fully validated. Ran full pytest suite serially (-n 0) => 146 passed, 1 skipped, 1 warning in 75s — matching the expected 138 (Phase 0-5) + 8 (Phase 6) baseline with zero regressions. Additionally hit the production preview URL (https://mobile-roster-3.preview.emergentagent.com) via curl to prove all Phase 6 endpoints route through Kubernetes ingress correctly. All attestation verdicts (stub_accepted, ok for JWS, invalid_structure, ok for iOS base64), all cron auth paths (missing header 401, wrong secret 401, correct secret 200, idempotency duplicate:true on replay), and Phase 0-5 dashboard endpoints (/api/offices, /api/employees, /api/auth/login dual-mode with cookies + access_token/refresh_token body) confirmed working against the ingress. The deadman-sweep silent-push poke assertion was verified inside pytest (test_deadman_sweep_pokes_stale_employee monkey-patches _within_active_hours) — an additional live ingress attempt hit the design-documented out-of-window skip since current UTC hour is 3 (not 6..21), which is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: cron auth uses hmac.compare_digest — good, constant-time secret comparison prevents timing attacks
cron_runs collection has (name, run_id) unique index + 14-day TTL on ts — idempotency guard is DB-enforced, not just app-level

attestation validator is intentionally structural-only (JWS 3-segment shape / base64 shape / stub- prefix) — real Play Integrity + App Attest verification deferred to Phase 7 per review_request; mocked_apis section acknowledges this
attestation writes attestation_verdict on mobile_devices row and logs high-severity security_event for invalid_structure — auditability preserved
FCM push service is stubbed when FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON env missing; sweep still records last_deadman_poke_ms so the operational hook is exercised and observable
server.py cron_router is imported and mounted under /api prefix — ingress path validated end-to-end (401 without auth, 200 with correct bearer)
test_credentials: Owner admin akmaljn7@gmail.com / GeofenceAdmin123! and Employee employee@example.com / Employee123! — both verified working against ingress
seed_data_creation: Registered a transient mobile_devices row 'ingress-test-dev' and 'sweep-test-*' for ingress attestation/sweep validation, plus two cron_runs entries — all cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 is production-ready. Backend has 146 passing tests (1 skipped by design). When adding Phase 7 (real Google Play Integrity + Apple App Attest verification), the structural validator at routes/mobile.py:391 (_validate_attestation_structure) is the swap point — keep the verdict contract (stub_accepted / ok / invalid_structure / expired) intact so mobile clients don't need updates. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET path is proven working via /api/cron/deadman-tick and enforced with hmac.compare_digest. cron_runs collection has (name, run_id) unique index for idempotency. FCM push remains stubbed until FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is set.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 8 new Phase 6 tests plus 138 legacy tests pass, and ingress-level curl smoke on cron auth + attestation verdicts + admin dashboard endpoints all return expected results.
